items.title: Rabbit Praying on a Blue Mat
items.alt: A grey cartoon rabbit in a moon-pattern nightshirt kneels with clasped paws on a stitched blue mat beside a closed book.
items.description: Long complete ears, closed eyes and soft pink cheeks give the little fantasy animal a calm bedtime pose.

items.title: Peace and Blessings Dove Ribbon
items.alt: A flying white dove carries a teal ribbon reading “PEACE AND BLESSINGS” with a pink flower at one end.
items.description: Layered blue-grey feathers, a curled tail ribbon and tucked pink feet create a wide greeting graphic.

items.title: Count Your Blessings Checklist
items.alt: A wooden clipboard holds a “COUNT YOUR BLESSINGS” sheet with three empty checkboxes and writing lines.
items.description: A complete red pencil and two star stickers sit at the lower corner beneath the silver clip.

items.title: Bear Mailing a Blessings Letter Coloring Page
items.alt: A smiling cartoon bear posts a heart-sealed letter into a mailbox marked “BLESSINGS” in black outline.
items.description: A striped waistcoat, raised mailbox flag and open door give the complete mail-delivery scene clear coloring details.

items.title: Family Planting a Blessings Tree Coloring Page
items.alt: A cartoon adult and two children plant a sapling in a rounded planter with a “BLESSINGS” sign in black outline.
items.description: One child tips a small watering can while the other helps press soil beside the leafy young tree.

items.title: Cross and Dove Window Coloring Page
items.alt: A pointed-arch window contains a central Christian cross, leaf-shaped panels and an upper dove in black outline.
items.description: Broad unshaded panes and a complete stone-style outer border define the independent stained-glass coloring design.
